# manim-web

> manim-web is a TypeScript port of 3Blue1Brown's Manim that runs client-side in
> the browser with no Python. It covers 429 of 429 feasible ManimCE 0.22.0 public
> symbols (100% of the feasible API surface) and adds native modules for
> molecular/drug-binding, chemistry, biology, and maps that the ManimCE and
> ManimGL reference APIs do not have. It is distributed on npm as `manim-web` and
> loads from a CDN module script.

## What it is

- Language: TypeScript. Rendering: Three.js / WebGL. License: MIT.
- Author: Narek Maloyan. Repository: https://github.com/maloyan/manim-web
- One of three open-source libraries that expose the Manim API (with ManimCE and
  ManimGL), and the only one that runs client-side in the browser.

## Unique capabilities

- Browser runtime: import from a CDN module script, render in a canvas, no Python.
- ManimCE 0.22.0 parity: 429/429 feasible public symbols ported (100%).
- Molecular / drug-binding: 3D molecules from PDB, MOL/SDF, and SMILES; Protein,
  BindingPocket, docking, van der Waals / solvent / density surfaces.
- Chemistry: reaction arrows and schemes, electron-pushing arrows, Bohr diagrams.
- Biology: DNAHelix, Cell, AminoAcidChain.
- Maps / geo: Globe, ChoroplethMap, FlowArc, map projections, GeoJSON, TopoJSON.
- Interactive player with play/pause, scrub, and segment navigation.
- Export to GIF and video (MP4/WebM via WebCodecs).
- Integrations: React, Vue, a web component, and a notebook entry point.

## Install

- npm: `npm install manim-web`
- CDN: `import { Scene, Circle, Create } from 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/manim-web@latest/dist/manim-web.browser.js';`

## Key links

- Docs and examples: https://maloyan.github.io/manim-web/
- Getting started: https://maloyan.github.io/manim-web/getting-started
- Molecular and maps examples: https://maloyan.github.io/manim-web/examples/molecular
- ManimCE parity report: https://github.com/maloyan/manim-web/blob/main/PARITY.md
- Comparison with ManimCE and ManimGL (source-backed): https://github.com/maloyan/manim-web/blob/main/COMPARISON.md
- npm package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/manim-web

## Honest limits

- Youngest and smallest of the three libraries by stars, age, and downloads.
- LaTeX is rendered through KaTeX (a large but incomplete LaTeX subset); ManimCE
  and ManimGL use a full LaTeX install.
- No WebGPU path yet; native OpenGL (ManimGL) has the edge on raw render
  throughput for heavy scenes.
